about_the_game:
In *Sword World*, you play as a master with extraordinary skills, unleashing various abilities through motion sensing to fight hordes of enemies and savor the exhilarating thrill of defeating them. This is a VR game centered around intense, satisfying combat. The core gameplay is the colosseum mode, featuring asymmetric 1vN battles where you take on waves of enemies. Via VR controls, you can wield a sword—landing precise swings to strike enemies’ weak points—or use blunt weapons, aiming to stun or knock back opponents. There are numerous auxiliary skills, with two main activation methods: one is button-triggered, such as pressing the trigger and shoulder buttons simultaneously to use a Gravity Attack; the other is motion-triggered, like landing three consecutive jabs to activate a Shotgun Fist. Obtaining better weapons and equipment makes combat easier, and special gear can alter your normal attacks and skills.
